text:
The judge should overrule the objection and admit the question. The witness's grand jury testimony was sworn and inconsistent with his trial testimony, so it is admissible to impeach him (FRE 607 lets a party impeach its own witness) and also as substantive evidence under FRE 801(d)(1)(A). That basis is the oath and the inconsistency, not how soon after the event the statement was made, and the recent-fabrication theory doesn't matter because the prior-inconsistent-statement route is enough.

CONFIDENCE: 70
